steps: Sit tall on a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your spine upright and shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that strengthens the arms and shoulders and builds balance. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: 1.Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
2.Inhale deeply, raising both shoulders gently toward your ears.
3.Exhale slowly, rolling shoulders forward and down in a smooth, circular motion. Repeat 5–8 times.
4.After finishing forward rolls, switch direction and roll shoulders forward 5–8 times, keeping movements fluid and relaxed.

exercises.cue: 1.Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.

exercises.name: Neck Circles
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that releases the neck and improves flexibility. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, spine upright, and shoulders loose.
Begin with your head upright, then slowly let your chin drop to the center of your chest.
From there, roll your head gently toward one shoulder, back through the center (chin down), then toward the other shoulder.
Continue this side-to-side circular flow 4–6 times, keeping movements slow and your breathing calm.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you rise · exhale as you sink
exercises.cue: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, spine upright, and shoulders loose.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that strengthens the arms and shoulders and improves flexibility. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: 1.Stand tall. Bring both hands together in front of the chest, palms facing each other, fingers interlaced.
2.Rotate both wrists together in a smooth circular motion, 5–8 times clockwise.
3.Reverse the direction, rotating wrists 5–8 times counterclockwise.
4.Release hands gently and let arms rest at the sides.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you rise · exhale as you sink
exercises.cue: 1.Stand tall. Bring both hands together in front of the chest, palms facing each other, fingers interlaced.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that strengthens the legs and improves flexibility. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: 1.Stand tall. Keep hands relaxed at the sides.
2.Shift weight to the left leg, gently lifting the right foot off the floor.
3.Rotate the right ankle slowly 5–8 times clockwise, then 5–8 times counterclockwise.
4.Place the right foot down, lift the left foot, and repeat the circles.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you rise · exhale as you sink
exercises.cue: 1.Stand tall. Keep hands relaxed at the sides.

exercises.name: Waist Circles
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that mobilises the spine and improves flexibility. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands resting lightly on your hips or lower abdomen.
Slowly shift your weight and begin circling your hips and waist in a smooth, continuous motion, keeping your upper body relaxed.
Complete 4–6 circles in one direction, moving steadily and without strain.
Reverse the direction for another 4–6 circles, breathing deeply and keeping the movement fluid.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you rise · exhale as you sink

exercises.name: Torso Twist
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that mobilises the spine and builds balance. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and both hands held loosely in front of your abdomen.
Gently twist your torso to one side, letting your arms move together as a unit across your body while the opposite heel lifts slightly.
Twist smoothly to the other side, keeping your hands in front and your movement relaxed.
Continue alternating sides for 8–12 twists, breathing naturally and maintaining a gentle, flowing rhythm.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you rise · exhale as you sink

exercises.name: Lifting the Qi
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that deepens the breath and builds balance. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: 1.Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at the sides.
2.Inhale, bend slightly at the knees and scoop downward with both hands as if gathering energy from the ground.
3.Exhale, open the arms out to the sides and upward to chest or shoulder height, palms facing out then take it in front of your face.
4.Return hands to the starting position and repeat 5–8 times, feeling calm and expanded.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that strengthens the arms and shoulders and improves flexibility. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: 1.Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, spine tall and shoulders relaxed — breathe deeply to settle your posture.
2.Lift both arms slowly to shoulder height (palms down), elbows soft, and start the circles from your shoulder joints.
3.Sweep the arms forward in slow, continuous circles (about 6–8 controlled reps), inhaling as they rise and exhaling as they lower.
4.Reverse direction for the same number of reps, gradually reduce the circle size, then lower your arms and shake out any tension.

exercises.name: Holding the Ball
exercises.description: A gentle standing Tai Chi movement that builds balance and deepens the breath. Move slowly, stay within a comfortable range and let your breath set the pace.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed. 2 .Inhale, raise both hands to chest height, palms facing each other as if holding a ball.
Exhale, then shift weight to one leg — place one hand high (palm in) and the other low (palm facing up), as if holding the ball on that side.

Inhale, smoothly switch sides: step or shift weight to the other leg, bringing the opposite hand up and the other down. Continue alternating 5–8 times per side, keeping movements slow and coordinated.

There is nothing you need to do right now. The day is complete.
Take a slow breath in through your nose… and a long, soft breath out.
Feel the weight of your body sinking into the bed beneath you.
Let your jaw soften. Let your shoulders fall away from your ears.
With each exhale, you drift a little deeper.
If thoughts arrive, let them float past like clouds over a moonlit lake.
Your breath is slow and easy now. Your body feels warm and heavy.
Imagine the cool, quiet water of a lake at night, perfectly still.
Every muscle releasing, every breath carrying you toward sleep.
You are safe. You are held. You can let go.

Welcome. Sit or lie comfortably, and allow your eyes to close or soften.
Let's take a moment to step out of the rush.

Imagine the sound around you washing your worries away.

Take one more deep breath, and when you're ready, gently open your eyes.

dailyChallenges.title: Hydrate like water flows
dailyChallenges.description: Drink 8 glasses of water today. Your joints will thank you.

dailyChallenges.title: Box breathing break
dailyChallenges.description: Pause for 2 minutes of 4-4-4-4 breathing before lunch.

dailyChallenges.title: 20 calf raises
dailyChallenges.description: Rise onto your toes 20 times while the kettle boils.

dailyChallenges.title: Cloud Hands at sunset
dailyChallenges.description: Practice Wave Hands Like Clouds for 3 minutes this evening.

dailyChallenges.title: Screens off by 9
dailyChallenges.description: Give your mind 30 screen-free minutes before bed.

dailyChallenges.title: Hourly posture check
dailyChallenges.description: Every hour, roll your shoulders back and lengthen your spine.

dailyChallenges.title: Three good things
dailyChallenges.description: Write down three things you're grateful for tonight.

dailyChallenges.title: Take the stairs
dailyChallenges.description: Choose stairs over the elevator whenever you can today.

dailyChallenges.title: Eat one meal slowly
dailyChallenges.description: Put your fork down between bites. Taste every mouthful.

dailyChallenges.title: Morning sunlight
dailyChallenges.description: Get 10 minutes of daylight within an hour of waking.

dailyChallenges.title: Desk stretch x3
dailyChallenges.description: Do a 1-minute neck and shoulder stretch three times today.

dailyChallenges.title: Share a smile
dailyChallenges.description: Smile at three people today — it's contagious calm.
